visionrealm.configuration.title: VisionRealm Configs
Configure screen overlay and particle effects
visionrealm.configuration.enableScreenOv: Whether to enable the screen overlay effect
When enabled, displays a dim filter and error-code particles on screen. Creates an unsettling atmosphere. May affect performance on low-end systems.
visionrealm.configuration.screenOverlayO:
Range: 70-125, higher values make it more opaque.
Actual opacity = this value / 100.
visionrealm.configuration.preventOverlay: Prevent overlays from obstructing other HUDs

Enabled: Screen effects won't cover other mod's interfaces
Disabled: Overlays may obscure parts of HUD
visionrealm.configuration.gameHud.toolti: Configure game HUD and screen visual effects
visionrealm.configuration.hudType.toolti:
Select the display style for in-game interface
• Default - Classic style
• ModernizeHud - Modern bar UI
visionrealm.configuration.hudPosition.to:
Set where the HUD appears on screen
§c§lNote: Custom position is not available for Default style§r

• AboveTheInventory - Above hotbar (default)
• TopLeft - Top-left corner
• TopRight - Top-right corner
• Custom - Custom position
visionrealm.configuration.modernizeHudSh:
[ModernizeHud only] Show values on progress bars
Enabled: Shows exact values (e.g., 85/100)
Disabled: Shows progress bars only
[For styles other than ModernizeHud] Show numeric values
Enabled: Shows numbers
Disabled: Shows icons/progress bars only
visionrealm.configuration.administratorV: Whether Administrator entities can be attacked

If disabled, Administrators will still only be immune to the vast majority of damage.
Some special damage (e.g., void damage) still affect them.
